# Claims, checked on paper

<!-- Generated by bench/claims.py; edit that, never this. -->

Figures other people published, checked against the ceiling with the ledger's arithmetic and kept out of the ledger: nothing here was measured in this repository ([CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)). 26 rows from 21 published figures, collected 2026-10-17. Bytes per step are read from each weight file's header (`bench/models/weight_files.json`), bandwidth from the device's passport (`bench/passports.py`); the verdicts are [GLOSSARY.md](GLOSSARY.md)'s, *Claims table*.

## Single stream

The ceiling is at zero context, so each share is a lower bound: the KV a real context adds lowers the ceiling. *Stand-in* marks a page that publishes the precision but not the file.

## Precision not disclosed

The page names no precision, so no share is computed; the claim bounds the bytes a step can read, and the files of that model are tested against the bound.

## Seats and prices

A price is checked against a floor: prefill at 100 % of the card's dense FP8, at the claimant's own hourly rate. For output the ratio is an upper bound on the margin, since one card does not batch decode to its compute limit.

| | Claim | Check | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| x02 | DGX Spark, SGLang, Llama-3.1-8B FP8: 368 tok/s at batch 32 | share at least 0.34, the share at zero context; the context is not published, and the rate is possible only below 3,745 tokens per sequence with a BF16 KV cache, 7,490 with FP8 | condition not disclosed |
| c07 | MI300X, vLLM, Llama-3.3-70B FP8: 1,482 tok/s per GPU at 50 tok/s per user | their price bills 1,466 tok/s per GPU, so the figure counts input and output; output is 165 tok/s, 3.3 sequences per GPU. Share 0.75 at TP 1, 0.17 at TP 8 (BF16 KV); TP is not published. Read as output tokens, the figure is over the ceiling at TP 1 (1.46) and TP 2 (1.13) | condition not disclosed |
| c08 | H100, Llama-3.1-8B BF16: 107 concurrent users at 4K context | (80 GB × 0.90 − 16.06 GB) / (131,072 B × 4,096) = 104 seats, 114 if the 80 GB is GiB. A capacity, not a service: no TPOT target is set, and a target lowers it ([SLO.md §6](SLO.md#6-concurrency-ceiling)) | within ceiling |
| c09 | DeepInfra, Llama-3.3-70B FP8: $0.10 / $0.32 per 1M | floor $0.043/1M: 139 GFLOP per token on 100 % of an H100's dense FP8 at DeepInfra's $2.20/h. Input 2.3× the floor, output 7.5× | above floor |
| c10 | Together, Llama-3.3-70B FP8: $1.04 / $1.04 per 1M | floor $0.078/1M: 139 GFLOP per token on 100 % of an H100's dense FP8 at Together's $3.99/h. Input 13.4× the floor, output 13.4× | above floor |
| x05 | DeepInfra, Qwen3-32B FP8: $0.08 / $0.28 per 1M | floor $0.020/1M: 64 GFLOP per token on 100 % of an H100's dense FP8 at DeepInfra's $2.20/h. Input 4.0× the floor, output 14.2× | above floor |

## Refused

| | Claim | Why | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| c15 | Jetson AGX Thor, Qwen3-8B NVFP4 + EAGLE3: 153.7 tok/s | speculative decoding accepts ~4 tokens per weight pass; against the one-pass ceiling it would read as a share of 2.90 | out of regime |
| c13 | DGX Spark, Ollama, gpt-oss-120b MXFP4: 41.14 tok/s | sliding-window attention on alternate layers, which the ceiling does not model | out of regime |
| c14 | DGX Spark, Ollama, Gemma 3 27B Q4_K_M: 10.83 tok/s | sliding-window attention, which the ceiling does not model | out of regime |
| c12 | Groq LPU, Llama-3.1-8B: 560 tok/s per user | weights held in on-chip SRAM across many chips; no device-memory ceiling applies | out of regime |
| x06 | Cerebras CS-3, Llama-3.3-70B: 2,200 tok/s | weights held in wafer-scale SRAM; no device-memory ceiling applies | out of regime |
| c11 | 8× B300, Llama-3.1-8B: 171,114 tok/s, MLPerf Offline | no B300 passport, and the dataset's token lengths are not on the page | not checked |
